message.reasoning_content:
We need produce JSON only. Need evaluate each story for Atomic criterion. Need understand atomic: one feature; violation if combines two or more independently implementable/testable/prioritizable features. Don't flag conjunctions that enumerate attributes of one feature.

Need go through all 69 stories. Need decide. Some are clearly atomic. Some combine clauses with "and" maybe multiple features. Need be careful: do not over-flag simple attribute lists (BC-015 many fields for one dedicated page, maybe still one feature: dedicated page showing info. BC-016 training options clearly marked for info fields: one feature listing training options with attributes. BC-017 landing page with intro section and list all training offerings and promote call for trainings? Could be one landing page feature with sections? Maybe combines list offerings and call for trainings promotion. But call for trainings may be separate feature. Need decide. BC-005 as trainer edit training node and links to slides? "so that training coordinators don't have to and links to slides" weird. It may combine edit training node and links to slides maybe two? Need decide. BC-010 cancellation deadline tied to workflow one feature? likely one.

Need analyze all.

Set criteria is individual. Need mainly own text. But if story combines multiple features. Need decide.

We need output exactly 69 evaluations. Need be consistent.

Approach: For each story, extract main feature(s). We can flag violation where story text contains two features connected by "and" that are independently implementable/testable. Need not flag enumerations of attributes.

Let's list.

BC-001: "view a list of sponsors" one feature. Atomic no violation.

BC-002: "view list of user profiles" one feature. no.

BC-003: "email all trainers at once from website for info and updates" one feature: email all trainers. no.

BC-004: "have a very clear map where buildings and rooms are" one feature: map. no.

BC-005: "As a trainer, I want to edit my training node myself, so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides." This sentence is malformed: "so that ... and links to slides" maybe they want to edit training node and links to slides? "edit my training node myself, so that ... and links to slides." Actually "and links to slides" seems another wanted feature: add links to slides. Could be interpreted as within training node editing, include links to slides? Maybe "edit my training node myself... and links to slides" two: edit node and links to slides. But maybe links to slides are part of training node content. The exact phrase: "I want to edit my training node myself, so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides." Hmm "so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides" doesn't parse. Could be "edit training node myself, so that coordinators don't have to" plus "[I want to add] links to slides"? Could flag atomic because combines editing training node and links to slides. But maybe "links to slides" is part of training node editing. Need evidence. This is a candidate violation.

BC-006: "limit to one registration per day per authenticated user" one feature. no.

BC-007: "admin view that helps track registration status for each attendee so that we can see attendend, refunded, no show." one feature: admin view track statuses. no.

BC-008: "be added to a training waitlist" one feature. no.

BC-009: "must accept cancellation terms with a checkbox" one feature. no.

BC-010: "tie in a cancellation deadline to whatever registration / cancellation workflow exists" one feature. no.

BC-011: "add to 'my schedule' if there is a schedule feature on the site" one feature: add to my schedule. no.

BC-012: "see which trainings I have signed up for" one feature. no.

BC-013: "have a view attached to training node that shows all attendee information Trainers can see all class attendance at first because there are so little trainers..." One feature: trainer view of attendee info. no.

BC-014: "admin view where all trainee information is shown and can be filtered to show a single training session" Is this one feature: admin view with filtering. Filtering is attribute/function of the view. Could be considered one feature. No violation.

BC-015: "dedicated page for each class to learn more... following info: Logo, title, trainers, location, possibly a map view, datetime, skill level, registrations remaining, link to register... URL path SEO friendly /training/training-title" This is one feature: class detail page with attributes. "so that I can choose the right class, AND the trainer can tweet and promote their class." Could be one feature but has two benefits? Atomic one feature. The list of information are attributes. No violation likely.

BC-016: "training options clearly marked for following information... so that I can shop for training all with one page AND find their class on on one page." One feature: training options list/page with fields. No violation. Enumerates attributes. No split.

BC-017: "training landing page with an intro section and a list of all training offerings and promote call for trainings, so that I can shop for training all with one page and we can have a call for trainings for selection." This potentially combines: (1) training landing page with intro and list offerings, and (2) call for trainings promotion/selection? It says landing page with intro and list all training offerings and promote call for trainings. Are these parts of one landing page feature? Maybe yes, a landing page containing intro, list offerings, and call for trainings. But "call for trainings for selection" could be separate feature (call for trainers to submit) not just landing page display. But text "landing page with ... and promote call for trainings" maybe just a section on landing page. Since atomic: expresses requirement for exactly one feature. A landing page with multiple sections may still be one feature (page). But if "call for trainings" is independently implementable (form/process?), then violation. Need decide. Backlog has no separate call for trainings story. The story text includes "promote call for trainings" as part of landing page. It may be one landing page with promo section. I lean no violation: all content of one landing page. However it says "so that I can shop for training all with one page and we can have a call for trainings for selection." That indicates two goals: shopping and call for trainings. The "call for trainings for selection" implies ability to submit? Hmm. But requirement is "landing page with an intro section and a list of all training offerings and promote call for trainings" - all are page content. Not multiple features. Maybe no violation.

BC-018: "link on home page to a list of training options" one feature. no.
